messages.subject: Bayesian Mixer London
parts:
Hi all,

Thanks to all of you, who came along to the first Bayesian Mixer Meetup last Friday!

Jon and I had a great time; so much, that we’d like to organise another Meetup around mid-April again.

In order to organise our next (and forthcoming) events Jon set up a ‘proper’ Meetup site: http://www.meetup.com/Bayesian-Mixer-London/

Please feel free to register there and share ideas, comments, etc.

Of course, if you have proposal for talks and/or venues then please do get in touch.

Finally, you find some brief comments and links to the files from last Friday’s event on my blog:
http://www.magesblog.com/2016/02/bayesian-mixer-on-meetup.html

Best regards

Markus

—
Markus Gesmann
Blog: www.magesblog.com
